symptom: a settled re-run of 600 `create or modify page` statements spent 21 s in describePage: 1,800 describes of about 11.6 ms each, and 90,000 GetPage calls for 600 pages (ako/mxcli#2160)
cause: describePage found its page with pagesWhere(name == local name), which loads every page of that local name in every module and leaves the module to pickDescribed; the seed has the same page names in 30 modules, as real projects have Overview, NewEdit and Home in most of theirs. It then read the page's raw document twice, once for the layout and once inside getPageWidgetGroupsFromRaw, decoding the whole page into a map each time. A rewrite describes the stored page up to three times (the unauthorable-widget guard in the check and in the exec, and the pluggable passthrough), so both costs are paid per statement
insight: My estimate for 'stored-page describe' was 31 s, from wall-clock timers; it double-counted checkNoHiddenContentRebuilt, which is inside loadPluggablePassthrough's total, and the real figure was 23 s. Timing the pieces separately before designing anything showed the parse of the description was 0.5 s and describePage itself 21 s, which moved the work from 'describe less often' to 'make one describe cheap'. The 90,000 GetPage calls were in the first timer table and read as a curiosity at 3.2 s; they were the visible part of a per-describe cost whose decoding the profiler could not attribute (CPU-profile stacks stop at 64 frames, pages nest deeper). The module filter moved from after the load to before it changes no result: pickDescribed only ever picked among pages its own module predicate accepted. Measured: units loaded describing a page with four namesakes 6 -> 2; the 600-page settled re-run 87.8 s -> 77.2 s; describe output of three pages and the script's output identical to the previous binary.
